# funtohard - Design, Software & Philosophy
> Design and software development portfolio, learning tools, and independent philosophy research by funtohard.

## Main Sections
- [/work/](https://funtohard.github.io/work/): Selected design and development projects, with interface decisions and implementation context.
- [/philosophy](https://funtohard.github.io/philosophy): Philosophy research journal with formal proofs, citations, analytical frameworks, and thought streams.
- [/philosophy/research](https://funtohard.github.io/philosophy/research): Long-form research papers with formal proofs, citations, and analytical frameworks.
- [/philosophy/thoughts](https://funtohard.github.io/philosophy/thoughts): Short-form philosophical reflections, essays, micro-thoughts, and conceptual observations.
- [/philosophy/topics](https://funtohard.github.io/philosophy/topics): Topic taxonomy including Epistemology, Logic, Ethics, Philosophy, Metaphysics, and Mind.
- [/R-mergency](https://funtohard.github.io/R-mergency): Emergency exam cram kits, drill sets, and cheat sheets for university courses.

## Key Research Topics
1. **Epistemological Limits & Semantics**: The paradox of definition, semantic observer effects, and natural language syntax normalization.
2. **Philosophy of Computation & Systems Programming**: Formal abstract virtual machines, compiler semantic contracts, and Undefined Behavior.
3. **Ethics & Intellectual History**: Epistemic injustice, collaborative authorship, and historical erasure in philosophical partnerships.
